title: Godot release policy
key_points: Godot follows Semantic Versioning with major.minor.patch versioning.
Major versions have compatibility-breaking changes, minor versions add features without breaking compatibility, and patch releases fix bugs.
Stable branches receive support until the next one is released and gets its first patch update.
Pre-release versions are for testing only.
limitations: Support depends on core contributors' choices and community needs.
Upgrading can be risky; make backups or use version control.
Not all third-party docs may cover the latest major version features.
asserts: Godot's release policy involves constantly evolving stable branches, with support lasting until the next one is released and has received its first patch update.
